small_guidance:
- The current kernel recomputes the full ConvTranspose3d output from scratch per (n, oc), redoing IC*KD*KH*KW work for every output position with no reuse. Tuning BLOCK_IC / num_warps will not close a 70× gap; at minimum, swap the loop order so the outer loop is over input voxels (n, ic, id, ih, iw) and scatter-add into a per-(n, oc) output buffer in shared memory / registers, then pool.
- If keeping the gather structure, add `@triton.autotune` over BLOCK_IC ∈ {4, 8, 16}, num_warps ∈ {1, 2, 4}, num_stages ∈ {2, 3}, and parallelize over (n, oc, pd) instead of just (n, oc) so the 8×8×16 = 1024 pooled-position serial loop is split across more SMs (currently only 128*16 = 2048 programs, each doing ~1M FLOPs serially).
- Precompute `inv_total` and hoist the `num_d/id_/valid_d` and `num_h/ih_/valid_h` computations out of the inner kw / ic loop — currently they're recomputed every kw iteration.
large_guidance:
- Rewrite as scatter-add ConvTranspose3d: one program per (n, ic-tile, id, ih, iw) loads the input voxel and the (OC, KD, KH, KW) weight slice, computes the outer product, and atomic-adds into a materialized (N, OC, OD, OH, OW) output tensor. Then run a separate fused (scale + maxpool + global-avg + clamp) reduction kernel — one program per (n, oc) reducing over OD*OH*OW with a 2×2×2 max in registers. This matches the recommended ConvTranspose scatter-add pattern in the skills and avoids the ~512× redundant gather work the current kernel does.
- Alternative: implement ConvTranspose3d as an im2col-style GEMM where the "K" axis is (IC*KD*KH*KW) with masked validity, one program per (n, OC-tile, output-spatial-tile), using tl.dot with BLOCK_M=16 (OC), BLOCK_N=64-128 (spatial), BLOCK_K=32. Fuse scale into the epilogue, write to a (N, OC, OD, OH, OW) buffer, then run a tiny pool+avg+clamp kernel.
- Fusion boundary: do NOT try to fuse conv-transpose + maxpool + GAP into one kernel as the current code does — the data dependency (every conv output contributes to exactly one max-pool window, every max contributes to one GAP) means a 2-kernel split (conv-transpose with fused scale → fused max/avg/clamp reduction) is both simpler and dramatically faster because the conv output is materialized once and reused.
